text: I gave it a try, interestingly still wrong and idk why, if you do horizontal cuts (i did 5 of them) they cut fine, then do one vertical cut and it somehow cant hit the top most face, yet if you start from a vertical cut it will gladly cut the entire pyramid vertically, so it has nothing to do with the fact that there is a tip, its simply just deciding to not go the last face for some reason
